description: Verified model-name and reasoning-effort capability matrix per harness. scripts/model-policy.mjs fails closed on model names and reasoning efforts not covered here, so a policy can never project a value that would 404 (OpenAI: HTTP 404 invalid_request_error/model_not_found; OpenRouter: HTTP 404) or be silently dropped at request time. Namespaces are evaluated in order; first 'match' wins. Human-readable matrix: docs/model-policy-matrix.md. Refresh workflow: .claude/skills/model-registry-refresh/SKILL.md.

codex.reasoning_note: Codex validates effort at runtime against each model's advertised supportedReasoningEfforts (model/list); the registry narrows per model family below. o-series models predate none/minimal/xhigh; "max" is advertised only by the gpt-6 and gpt-5.6 families. The Codex ReasoningEffort enum carries None|Minimal|Low|Medium|High|XHigh|Max|Ultra|Persistent plus a Custom(String) fallback, and the config schema types the key as a free-form non-empty string, so the harness itself does not reject a value — the narrowing here is what makes an unsupported pairing fail at check time instead of at the provider.

namespaces.description: OpenAI first-party text/coding models served by Codex's default provider. Image, audio, and video model slugs are deliberately excluded — they are not valid agent models.

namespaces.description: Local models served by Ollama, routed via a [model_providers.ollama] table (base_url http://localhost:11434/v1, wire_api responses) in the operator's codex config. Policy values must pin an explicit name:tag — floating :latest via a bare name is rejected by shape.
namespaces.reasoning_note: Ollama's OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions documents reasoning_effort with values none|low|medium|high|max (verified 2026-09-05), so the vocabulary here mirrors that endpoint exactly — note it has no minimal and no xhigh. Per-model support is narrower than the endpoint union (gpt-oss documents low|medium|high; glm-5.3 documents low|high|max), and this is an open namespace so the registry cannot gate per model. Codex applies model_reasoning_effort globally rather than per provider (it is a single Option<ReasoningEffort> on the config, and model_provider_id is likewise global), so the value is not stripped when the active provider is a custom one; the operator still confirms their local server honours it.
sources: https://ollama.com/library (tag lists per model page, verified 2026-09-05)

namespaces.description: OpenRouter-served models, routed via a [model_providers.openrouter] table (base_url https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, env_key OPENROUTER_API_KEY, wire_api responses) in the operator's codex config. Slug form author/model with optional :free/:extended/:nitro/:thinking variant. The floating ~author/family-latest alias form is deliberately rejected — policy pins exact models.
namespaces.reasoning_note: OpenRouter documents reasoning.effort / reasoning_effort with none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max — the same seven values as the codex harness vocabulary (verified 2026-09-05). As with the ollama namespace, Codex applies model_reasoning_effort globally rather than per provider, so it is not stripped on a custom route. Per-model support is narrower than this union and cannot be gated in an open namespace, so an unsupported pairing surfaces at the provider rather than at check time.

claude-code.reasoning_note: Subagent frontmatter effort field (low|medium|high|xhigh|max). https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents states available levels depend on the model, and the models overview lists Claude Haiku 4.5 as not supporting effort at all — so the haiku entries below carry an empty reasoning_efforts and fail closed. The remaining models accept the full vocabulary.
